assertions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE assertions(assertion_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,field TEXT NOT NULL,raw_value TEXT,normalized_value TEXT,source_record_id TEXT REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id),field_locator TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(operation_id))

cluster_checks.create_sql: CREATE TABLE cluster_checks(merge_pair_id TEXT NOT NULL,left_asin TEXT NOT NULL,right_asin TEXT NOT NULL,decision TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(merge_pair_id,left_asin,right_asin))

credits.create_sql: CREATE TABLE credits(credit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,movie_id TEXT NOT NULL,person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people(person_id),role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('director','starring','cast')),credit_order INTEGER,raw_name TEXT NOT NULL,source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id),assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id),scope TEXT NOT NULL)

cross_edition_candidates.create_sql: CREATE TABLE cross_edition_candidates(candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,left_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,right_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL)

editions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE editions(asin TEXT PRIMARY KEY,classification TEXT NOT NULL,mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT,medium TEXT NOT NULL,language TEXT NOT NULL,subtitles TEXT NOT NULL,region_code TEXT,distributor TEXT,product_release_date TEXT,review_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(review_count>0))

etl_runs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE etl_runs(run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,stage TEXT NOT NULL,started_at TEXT NOT NULL,finished_at TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL,input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)

field_selections.create_sql: CREATE TABLE field_selections(selection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,field TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('selected','missing','unresolved')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(operation_id),UNIQUE(entity_type,entity_id,field))

identity_candidate_sources.create_sql: CREATE TABLE identity_candidate_sources(movie_id TEXT,tconst TEXT,source_record_id TEXT REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id),source_role TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(movie_id,tconst,source_record_id,source_role),FOREIGN KEY(movie_id,tconst) REFERENCES work_match_candidates(movie_id,tconst))

lineage_edges.create_sql: CREATE TABLE lineage_edges(child_kind TEXT NOT NULL,child_id TEXT NOT NULL,parent_kind TEXT NOT NULL,parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(child_kind,child_id,parent_kind,parent_id,role))

logical_reviews.create_sql: CREATE TABLE logical_reviews(logical_review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,asin TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_products(asin),raw_record_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,representative_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(asin,raw_record_sha256))

mapping_history.create_sql: CREATE TABLE mapping_history(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,event TEXT NOT NULL,rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL)

movie_genres.create_sql: CREATE TABLE movie_genres(movie_id TEXT REFERENCES movies(movie_id),genre TEXT NOT NULL,assertion_id TEXT REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id),PRIMARY KEY(movie_id,genre,assertion_id))

movie_person.create_sql: CREATE TABLE movie_person(movie_id TEXT REFERENCES movies(movie_id),person_id TEXT REFERENCES people(person_id),role TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(movie_id,person_id,role))

movies.create_sql: CREATE TABLE movies(movie_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES work_matches(movie_id),canonical_title TEXT,identity_status TEXT NOT NULL,tconst TEXT,release_year INTEGER,release_date TEXT,date_precision TEXT NOT NULL,runtime_minutes INTEGER,genres TEXT NOT NULL,directors TEXT NOT NULL,starring TEXT NOT NULL,cast TEXT NOT NULL)

operations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE operations(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES etl_runs(run_id),parents TEXT NOT NULL)

pairs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE pairs(pair_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,left_asin TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES editions(asin),right_asin TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES editions(asin),proposed_decision TEXT NOT NULL,final_decision TEXT NOT NULL,rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL,rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK(left_asin<right_asin))

people.create_sql: CREATE TABLE people(person_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,nconst TEXT UNIQUE,canonical_name TEXT NOT NULL,identity_status TEXT NOT NULL,birth_year INTEGER,death_year INTEGER,name_source_record_id TEXT REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id))

person_aliases.create_sql: CREATE TABLE person_aliases(alias_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people(person_id),raw_name TEXT NOT NULL,normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL,movie_id TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id),assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id))

person_decisions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE person_decisions(decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,movie_id TEXT,raw_name TEXT,role TEXT,person_id TEXT REFERENCES people(person_id),status TEXT,reason TEXT,evidence TEXT)

person_evaluation_pairs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE person_evaluation_pairs(pair_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,left_alias_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person_aliases(alias_id),right_alias_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person_aliases(alias_id),stratum TEXT NOT NULL)

product_movie.create_sql: CREATE TABLE product_movie(asin TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES editions(asin),movie_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(movie_id),relationship TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship IN ('single_work','contains')),evidence TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(asin,movie_id))

product_status.create_sql: CREATE TABLE product_status(asin TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES editions(asin),mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL)

raw_reviews.create_sql: CREATE TABLE raw_reviews("source_review_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,"source_file_sha256" TEXT,"raw_record_sha256" TEXT,"record_sequence" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"product_id" TEXT REFERENCES review_products(asin),"reviewer_id" TEXT REFERENCES reviewers(reviewer_id),"profile_name" TEXT,"helpfulness_raw" TEXT,"score_raw" TEXT,"review_time_raw" TEXT,"summary" TEXT,"review_text" TEXT,"helpful_votes" INTEGER,"total_votes" INTEGER,"helpfulness_ratio" REAL,"score" REAL,"review_time_unix" INTEGER,"review_time_utc" TEXT,"quality_issues" TEXT,"encoding_issue_fields" TEXT,"raw_record_base64" TEXT,"byte_start" INTEGER,"byte_end" INTEGER,"start_line" INTEGER,"end_line" INTEGER,"run_id" TEXT,"parser_version" TEXT,"rule_version" TEXT,"summary_clean" TEXT,"review_text_clean" TEXT,"logical_review_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_reviews(logical_review_id),"clean_rule_version" TEXT,"clean_run_id" TEXT)

release_info.create_sql: CREATE TABLE release_info(movie_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES work_matches(movie_id),release_year INTEGER,release_date TEXT,date_precision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(date_precision IN ('year','day','unknown')),region TEXT,release_type TEXT,year_reason TEXT NOT NULL,date_reason TEXT NOT NULL,inferred_upper_bound TEXT,inference_reason TEXT NOT NULL,source_record_id TEXT REFERENCES source_records(source_record_id),assertion_id TEXT REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id))

review_assertion_sources.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_assertion_sources(assertion_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id),source_review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_reviews(source_review_id))

review_field_rules.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_field_rules(field TEXT PRIMARY KEY,raw_prefix TEXT NOT NULL,raw_column TEXT NOT NULL,normalized_column TEXT NOT NULL,operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,semantics TEXT NOT NULL)

review_products.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_products(asin TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

review_runs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_runs(run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,started_at TEXT,finished_at TEXT,status TEXT)

review_source_registry.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_source_registry(source_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_url TEXT NOT NULL,source_path TEXT NOT NULL,downloaded_at TEXT,missing_time_reason TEXT)

review_state.create_sql: CREATE TABLE review_state(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL)

reviewers.create_sql: CREATE TABLE reviewers(reviewer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

selection_members.create_sql: CREATE TABLE selection_members(selection_id TEXT REFERENCES field_selections(selection_id),assertion_id TEXT REFERENCES assertions(assertion_id),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('selected','not_selected')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(selection_id,assertion_id))

source_records.create_sql: CREATE TABLE source_records(source_record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,archive_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,record_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_start INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_end INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,raw_record BLOB NOT NULL,url TEXT,acquired_at TEXT,UNIQUE(source_id,archive_sha256,record_sequence))

stage_state.create_sql: CREATE TABLE stage_state(stage TEXT PRIMARY KEY,input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT REFERENCES etl_runs(run_id))

target_state.create_sql: CREATE TABLE target_state(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

upstream_registrations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE upstream_registrations(stage TEXT PRIMARY KEY,registration TEXT NOT NULL)

work_match_candidates.create_sql: CREATE TABLE work_match_candidates(movie_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work_matches(movie_id),tconst TEXT NOT NULL,qualified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qualified IN (0,1)),evidence TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(movie_id,tconst))

work_matches.create_sql: CREATE TABLE work_matches(movie_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,tconst TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL)

works.create_sql: CREATE TABLE works(movie_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,anchor_source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,status TEXT NOT NULL,display_title TEXT,display_title_source TEXT,rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL)

semantics.movie_id: Source-anchored system work ID; provisional unless supported. Not ASIN.
semantics.person_id: External-context anchor or explicit provisional source context; not name-only.
semantics.release_date: Calendar date only; year-only data never fake January1.
semantics.genres: Normalized member table with assertion-specific provenance.
semantics.raw_reviews: Every source record retained, raw/clean columns separated.
semantics.logical_reviews: Exact within-product full-record hash, differences checked; mapping is raw_reviews.logical_review_id.
semantics.field_selections: NULL plus explicit reason when missing/unresolved; chosen and unchosen candidates retained.
semantics.source_records: Metadata/IMDb retained raw bytes plus archive version, sequence, offsets, URL and acquisition time.
semantics.review_field_lineage: Virtual per-review per-field provenance; no materialization inflation. Source registry records unknown historical download time honestly.
